name: HRG_GOAL_PLN_ASSIGNMENTS
description: Stores goal plan assignment details (mapping of goal plan and assignments).

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: The system generated surrogate key for this entry

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_BUSINESS_GROUPS

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRG_GOAL_PLANS_B, which holds ID of goal plan.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M, which holds assignment of worker

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person Id of the person to whom the goal plan is assigned to.

columns.name: REVIEW_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Review period Id of the goal plan assignment

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Reference to the organization to which goal plan is being created.

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique id for goal plan set.

columns.name: WEIGHTING
columns.description: Goal Plan weight assigned

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_START_DATE
columns.description: Goal Plan Start Date

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_END_DATE
columns.description: Goal Plan End Date

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_SET_START_DATE
columns.description: Goal Plan Set Start Date

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_SET_END_DATE
columns.description: Goal Plan Set End Data

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Staus for Goal Plan assignment record

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: Stores request status of the last ESS job submitted for this assignment record
